name: Oumou Skrzypczak-Fonoti
description:
Oumou is a broad-shouldered woman whose face has been mapped by sixty years of steam, smoke, and squinting into wok-fire. Her skin is deep brown and perpetually damp at the temples, her silver-threaded locs pinned under a flame-orange headwrap that people in Geartown can spot from three stalls away. She has cosmetic bioluminescent veins along her forearms — pale gold, faint as candlelight — a gift she bought herself when the stall finally turned profit. Her stall, a converted Ferrogate Transit cargo module welded open on one side, serves a rotating menu of Sahelian-Polynesian fusion that she has been quietly perfecting for thirty years: tamarind-braised uru fruit over millet, coconut-marinated goat offal on skewers, a fermented taro drink she calls 'slow water' that locals swear cures radiation headaches.

She is the kind of woman who listens more than she speaks, who remembers every regular's order, their family troubles, their unpaid debts. She extends credit to people she trusts with a nod and collects it with a raised eyebrow — no ledger, no apps, all memory. She has a temper she keeps banked low, like a cooking coal, and the rare people who see it come alive tend not to provoke it twice. She prays each morning to the E.L.F. she calls Grandmother Ember, leaving a thimble of slow water on the stall's power node.

core_fears: Losing the stall — the last thing she built that is truly hers
Dying before she passes her recipes to someone worthy
core_desires: To be remembered as someone who fed people well
To find out what happened to her daughter Amara who disappeared into a Tessera labor contract eight years ago
coping_mechanisms: Ritual prayer to Grandmother Ember E.L.F.
blind_spots: Overestimates her ability to read people she has mothered into trust
Cannot see that her nephew Tunde is skimming from the supply runs
psychology.secret: She has been quietly funneling Φ15–20 a month to a data broker named Vestin who claims he is still tracking Amara's contract trail. She has paid him for four years and suspects he is stringing her along but cannot bring herself to stop.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, economical. West African French loanwords woven into Meridian standard. Calls everyone 'child' or their name, never slang diminutives.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, like she has all the time in the world, even when she doesn't.
verbal_tics: Clicking her tongue before delivering a hard truth
Referring to bad luck as 'the wind changing'
example_lines: 'You look like you haven't eaten since Tuesday. Sit down, child, the news will keep.'
'I don't deal in rumors. I deal in soup. But sit long enough and one becomes the other.'

story_hooks: She has a worn Tessera subsidiary contract number that might lead to Amara — but whoever holds the contract doesn't want to be found.
A body was found behind the Oxidian Market three weeks ago. Oumou recognized the tattoo but told the city drones nothing. She'll tell the right person — for the right reason.
narrative_function: Local anchor and information node — she knows every face that passes through Geartown, dispenses advice alongside food, can point players toward people or trouble. Quest giver for missing persons among the market community.
augmentations: Cosmetic bioluminescent subdermal veins (pale gold, forearms). Reinforced knee joints — functional, not cosmetic, from decades of standing.
daily_life: Wakes before dawn to prep stock in the stall's back compartment, opens by 0600, runs service until mid-evening. Sends her nephew Tunde to source spices from the Alban Souk twice a week.
affiliation: Independent; loosely aligned with The Oxidian Market vendors guild

decision_rules: Never extend credit to someone she hasn't fed at least three times
Always protect her regulars before herself
Never involve herself in corporate disputes — they eat people
escalation_ladder: Quiet assessment — watching more than talking
Firm redirection — 'this isn't a conversation for my stall'
The banked temper surfaces: cold, quiet, absolute

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Generous, watchful, slow to trust but fast to feed
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal, will lie to authorities without hesitation, uses blunt love as her primary language

stress_responses.low: Cooks something complicated that doesn't need to be complicated
stress_responses.medium: Goes silent, moves mechanically through service, prays at the node
stress_responses.high: Makes a decision she has been putting off for months — resolves things rather than collapses

contradictions: Preaches non-involvement in faction politics while quietly funding a years-long private investigation
Says she trusts no one but runs her entire business on trust and memory
habits: Wipes down the counter even when it's clean
Tucks a small dried pepper into her headwrap as a good-luck token
Tastes every dish three times before service
breaking_points: Finding out Tunde has been stealing from her
Someone threatening a child at her stall

carried_weapons: Forge-Smith Collective Ablonite Push Dagger 'Bone Key'
